SEC: 170:2026-27/SK
September 10, 2026
The Manager - Listing 
National Stock Exchange of India Limited
Capital Market – Listing
Exchange Plaza, 5th Floor
Plot No. C/1, G Block
Bandra-Kurla Complex
Bandra (E), Mumbai 400 051
Dear Sir,
Re:
Disclosure under Reg. 30 read with Sch. III. Part A. Para A of SEBI (LODR) 
Regulations, 2015 – Participation in Institutional Investors’ Meeting 
We wish to inform you that today at 5.30 P.M., Mr. M. Ramaswamy, Chief Financial Officer had 
an interaction with Yes Securities Institutional Equities, Institutional Investor, regarding the busi­
ness performance of the Company for the quarter ended 30th June 2026. It was a one-to-one 
meet. 
Further, we hereby confirm that: 
1.
The interaction was primarily in the Q&A format.
2.
No Unpublished Price Sensitive Information (UPSI) was shared during the interaction. 
Thanking you,
Yours truly,
For Sundaram Finance Limited
P.N. Srikant
CCO & Company Secretary
P N 
SRIKANT
Digitally signed 
by P N SRIKANT
